origin.rerun: grep -n 'claude/' .github/workflows/*automerge*.yml .github/workflows/*pr-landing*.yml | head; # then list open PRs with landing:self on non-claude branches

what: The auto-merge relay (open-and-automerge / watch checks) attaches only to PRs whose head branch is claude/*. Seven landing:self PRs on other branches (#14176 sa-infra/*, #14086/#14060/#14087/#14076 exit-ops/*, #14085 m19-*, #14052 ca-deploy-*) sat green for hours with no merge check attached until the manager merged them by hand 2026-09-29 ~13:45Z. Either widen the relay's branch filter to any branch carrying a landing:self pr-landing file, or make pr-landing-guard FAIL a landing:self PR on a non-claude/ branch so the stall is loud.
